combat_history.event: Patriot famously (if controversially) engaged Iraqi Scud missiles.
combat_history.significance: The system's combat debut and an early lesson in BMD limits.

combat_history.event: A Ukrainian Patriot battery intercepted a Russian Kh-47M2 Kinzhal air-launched 'hypersonic' missile.
combat_history.significance: Demonstrated PAC-3 against a very high-speed threat.

modernization.description: New 360-degree radar and integrated battle-command network.
modernization.impact: Improves coverage and lets Patriot fire on tracks from other sensors.

vulnerabilities.description: Limited interceptors per battery are vulnerable to mass salvos.
vulnerabilities.context: Missile-heavy adversaries can overwhelm point defences.

vulnerabilities.description: Expensive interceptors used against cheap threats create an unfavourable cost ratio.
vulnerabilities.context: Drones/cruise missiles can be cheaper than the interceptor.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Point and area defence of bases, cities and forces; the common allied air-defence layer in the Indo-Pacific.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Layered beneath THAAD and Aegis BMD; networked via IBCS.
operational_patterns.readiness_notes: Ubiquitous and combat-proven; high global demand.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: THAAD covers high-altitude area defence; Patriot defends a smaller footprint at lower altitude.
S-400 offers far longer reach against aircraft; Patriot emphasises hit-to-kill ballistic defence and is combat-proven.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: Patriot vs S-400 in the export market.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: China's long-range SAM is more an area air defender than a hit-to-kill BMD system.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: Western vs Chinese air defence philosophy.

doctrine.role: Mainstay U.S./allied air- and missile-defence system covering aircraft, cruise and ballistic missiles.
doctrine.employment: PAC-3 hit-to-kill for ballistic threats and GEM-T for aircraft/cruise missiles, layered under THAAD/Aegis.
doctrine.design_philosophy: A flexible, upgradeable, widely-exported lower-to-mid defence tier.
doctrine.threat_context: The common air-defence backbone of Indo-Pacific allies in any Taiwan/Korea contingency.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read with THAAD (higher) and against the S-400 and HQ-9.
